scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the October 2 score-table rotation usable by ensuring the offline ScoreKeeper tablet can load the correct account beforehand.
Emerging Need: A future volunteer shift gains a login-verification prerequisite after the tablet migration; the necessary recovery address exists only in Cassian’s archived profile record.
Decision Context: The reset should wait until migration finishes, then must occur before the coordinator exports verified accounts for offline use.
Consequence: If the verification window passes, the shift remains scheduled but the needed login cannot be added at the range in time.

parameter.title: Indoor league score table rotation
parameter.description: Backup score-table rotation for Friday indoor league; tablet assignment details to follow.

parameter.subject: ScoreKeeper tablet migration starts Monday
parameter.body: The scoring tablets are being rebuilt for October league. Members should not reset old ScoreKeeper accounts this weekend; tokens generated before the migration batch will be discarded. The reset window will be posted after Monday's tablet image check.

parameter.subject: ScoreKeeper reset window for October rotations
parameter.body: The migration is complete. Anyone with an October score-table rotation must have their ScoreKeeper account verified before Tuesday, September 29 at 5:00 p.m.; unverified accounts will not be loaded onto the offline tablets. Use the recovery email recorded on your prior ScoreKeeper profile. The bulletin does not list individual recovery emails.

parameter.content: No range Wi-Fi Friday; I’m exporting verified ScoreKeeper accounts at 5 sharp today. If a rotation volunteer misses the reset, I can’t add that login on-site.

parameter.subject: ScoreKeeper export completed
parameter.body: The verified-account export for the October 2 tablets is complete. Accounts not verified by 5:00 p.m. were left off the offline tablet image, and the next export will run after Friday league.
